state: Ghosting, «Файлы cfg»: autoexec.cfg, Ctrl+F «bind», Enter: выделено первое совпадение, «1 из N»

$args.content:
// autoexec.cfg — HLSR, Half-Life 2: Ghosting Mod
echo "autoexec loaded"

// Movement
bind "w" "+forward"
bind "s" "+back"
bind "a" "+moveleft"
bind "d" "+moveright"
bind "space" "+jump"
bind "mwheeldown" "+jump"
bind "mwheelup" "+jump"
bind "ctrl" "+duck"
bind "shift" "+speed"
bind "e" "+use"
bind "r" "+reload"
bind "f" "impulse 100"
bind "q" "lastinv"

// Weapons
bind "1" "slot1"
bind "2" "slot2"
bind "3" "slot3"
bind "4" "slot4"
bind "5" "slot5"
bind "mouse1" "+attack"
bind "mouse2" "+attack2"

// Mouse
sensitivity "2.5"
m_rawinput "1"
m_filter "0"
m_customaccel "0"
zoom_sensitivity_ratio "1"

// Video
fps_max "300"
mat_vsync "0"
cl_showfps "1"
net_graph "0"

// Speedrun
alias "+jumpduck" "+jump; +duck"
alias "-jumpduck" "-jump; -duck"
bind "alt" "+jumpduck"
alias "save_quick" "save quick; echo saved; play buttons/button14; host_framerate 0; wait; wait; wait; echo ready"
bind "F6" "save_quick"
bind "F7" "load quick"
bind "F9" "toggleconsole"

// Ghosting
gh_ghost_color "255 128 0"
gh_ghost_alpha "180"
gh_show_names "1"
gh_trail_length "2"
gh_hud_timer "1"

echo "autoexec done"
